mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.gid, g.name, g.sort_order, g.create_time, COUNT(l.id) AS link_count FROM t_group g LEFT JOIN t_link l ON g.gid = l.gid AND l.del_flag = 0 WHERE g.username = #{username} AND g.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY g.sort_order ASC, g.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_link WHERE gid = #{gid} AND del_flag = 0
